data.one_liner: Lightweight, offline Flutter Quran package using QCF Hafs font for rendering Mushaf pages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a 60fps optimized offline Quran rendering engine using the QCF Hafs font, supporting page-by-page Mushaf views, vertical Surah lists, tajweed rules, word-level interaction, and smart search.
use_when: You are building an Islamic app requiring authentic Madinah Mushaf rendering.
You need 100% offline Quran display with low app size impact (~10MB).
You require word-level interaction and tajweed coloring features.
avoid_when: You need built-in translations out of the box (marked as upcoming).
You require an extensive audio synchronization framework right now.
strengths: Completely offline ready with built-in fonts and data.
Dual reading modes including 604-page Mushaf layout and vertical Surah list.
High performance with 60fps smooth scrolling and low memory footprint.
weaknesses: Translations and audio sync features are still listed as upcoming.
Page breaks differ between editions, requiring manual re-anchoring when switching.
data.setup_notes: Add qcf_quran_lite and scrollable_positioned_list to your dependencies.
